title: ОАЭ намерены инвестировать $46 млрд в экономику Германии

title: French economy falls behind rest of Europe: Slow growth, rising inflation and unemployment
snippet: Growth is not expected to exceed 0.4% in 2026, down from the previously forecast 0.7%, according to INSEE, the French National Institute of Statistics and Economic Studies. title: George Pataki on how New York responded to 9/11 and its lasting impact
snippet: Twenty-five years ago, George Pataki was governor of New York when the Sept. 11 attacks transformed his state and the country.
